{{Quote|Remember, people, this is the bridge up there. Be careful where you shoot. Too much damage and the prize crew won't speak to any of us for a month. Got it?''|[[Bria Tharen]]|<ref name="Rebel Dawn">''[[Rebel Dawn]]''</ref>}}
A '''prize crew''' was a collection of experts aboard a shuttle preparing to board and operate a conquered but not disabled craft whose crew was killed or captured. Computers techs, an [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]], a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] and damage control and repair teams made up the prize crew assembled by the [[Red Hand Squadron]] seeking to board [[Emancipator (CR90 corvette)|''Helot's Shackle'']].
